asked.item: Add assistant as a second user
How to give her access in Blotato

verdict.reason: The team access and login pages state that there is one user per account, no separate logins and no passwords, and they give the shared-login steps.

steps.text: Blotato supports one user per account.
Native multi-user and team-member access is not live yet and has no firm release date, so there are no separate teammate logins.
Blotato uses magic link authentication, so there is no password and no way to set one for your assistant.
To give your assistant access today, have her enter your email address when logging in, give her the authentication code sent to your email, and have her complete the login process.
